feed.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugins — Curated List · Awesome DSH Plugin

entry.title: daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat
entry.summary: A multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

entry.title: zh667/TokenLedger
entry.summary: Shows local DSH token usage by relay site, project, and model, with account balances and subscription quota windows.

entry.title: WFMinerva/dsh-turn-cost
entry.summary: Per-turn real cost under every assistant reply: CNY at official peak/off-peak rates with cache-hit ratio; reads local session logs only, zero telemetry, zero keys.

entry.title: xiaogu619520/dsh-plugin-task-panel
entry.summary: Task & Context Summary Floating Panel (todo tracking, file/system token breakdown, 8-way resize, shortcut).

entry.title: yoli-mi/dsh-client-ui-custom
entry.summary: Web theming (wallpaper, glass, accent, presets), keyboard shortcuts, usage stats, a plugin marketplace, a floating history strip, and user-message Markdown rendering.

entry.title: stopchewing/dsh-mcp-view
entry.summary: MCP servers & tools inventory panel: one-click floating panel from the sidebar that lists every MCP server and tool (transport, endpoint, JSON schema, last-used time), grouped by server, collapsed by default, with live search and refresh; last-used times come from real session logs.

entry.title: RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin
entry.summary: One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export + favorites + surprise-me. Purely native on DSH's token system.

entry.title: Braidy-Wu/dsh-conversation-minimap
entry.summary: A conversation minimap for the DSH Web GUI (ChatGPT desktop style): one evenly-spaced capsule anchor per user prompt, fish-eye bell-curve magnification on hover with full prompt preview, top/bottom edge fade, blue highlight that follows the current prompt, click to jump to the message, and automatic full-history loading.

entry.title: dsh-odette-skin
entry.summary: A Genshin Impact "Odette" themed DSH UI skin: dark/light dual-mode background images, frosted-glass overrides for 13 theme tokens, and a chibi mascot sidebar toggle; install via npm

entry.title: sjh9714/dsh-what-changed
entry.summary: Session-wide file change review. Lists every file the agent wrote this session with its hunks, counts refused writes separately from changes, and folds from a session projection.

entry.title: chenproton/dsh-history
entry.summary: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.

entry.title: session-titler
entry.summary: Two-phase session captioning: instant keyword captions while busy, budget-model refinement when idle.

entry.title: memory-vault
entry.summary: Cross-session persistent memory for coding agents: SQLite local storage, hybrid keyword/semantic retrieval, Web and MCP interfaces.

entry.title: IWAIBAOLI/dsh-with-pencil
entry.summary: Bring the official pen.dev Pencil into DeepSeek Harness via the official CLI: in-conversation .pen editing tools, optimized specifically for DeepSeek's text-only model.

entry.title: phelpsyacht/dshmath-manim
entry.summary: Manim CE based math animation plugin: 6 built-in templates (function/derivative/integral/geometry/polar/3D surface) plus a zero-code skill pack (math-animation / manim-codegen) - natural language to animated math videos, with AST static security validation.

entry.title: moon09300731/dsh-vision-tools
entry.summary: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a `vision_understand` tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.

entry.title: AlloyPlane/dsh-eye-vision
entry.summary: Vision bridge for text-only models: image_understand tool via any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API (OCR/UI analysis), with an allowed-directories whitelist.

entry.title: moon09300731/dsh-approval-gate
entry.summary: Risk-gated approval automation: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe).

entry.title: dsh-verify
entry.summary: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec drives real headless Chromium, asserts computed styles and pixel diffs, returns an HTML report and 0/1 exit code; ships npm CLI, GitHub Action, and MCP server.

entry.title: safety-net
entry.summary: Destructive-command interception gate: parses and requires human approval for rm -rf / git reset --hard / push --force before execution (dsh plugin + standalone CLI).

entry.title: context-pruner
entry.summary: Session context triage: prunes stale, repeated, failed and oversized context to save token budget.

entry.title: command-scout
entry.summary: Scans declared project build commands (Makefile, package.json scripts, justfile, deno tasks) and exposes them as agent tools.

entry.title: browser-automation
entry.summary: Web Bridge: real-browser automation MCP server — navigation, click, form-fill, screenshots, JS execution, accessibility-snapshot driven.

entry.title: github-mcp
entry.summary: repogate: GitHub developer workbench MCP server — repos, issues, PRs, code review, search, zero runtime dependencies.

entry.title: snippet-expander
entry.summary: Steno: inline #tag shorthand expansion before send — multi-library, aliases, {{variables}}, recursion guards.

entry.title: secret-guard
entry.summary: Blocks agents from reading/writing sensitive files, masks leaked secrets in tool results, with an audit journal.

entry.title: adversarial-review
entry.summary: gavel-review: adversarial multi-perspective code review — parallel attack lenses, static sentinels, severity grading.

entry.title: docs-retriever
entry.summary: doctrove: versioned library documentation retrieval MCP server, zero runtime dependencies.

entry.title: fs-mcp
entry.summary: paddock: constrained local filesystem MCP server — file access confined to configurable zones, zero runtime dependencies.

entry.title: worktree-mgr
entry.summary: Task-isolated git worktrees: auto-create, sync and tear down isolated workspaces per task.
